steps.title: Discover the new Referee Audit card
steps.narration: Let's check out the newest addition to the Research hub — a report that checks whether Trendora's own fact-checker can be trusted.
steps.point_out: Scroll to 'Governance & process' — there are 4 cards now instead of 3, and the newest one is 'Referee audit.'

steps.title: Open the Referee Audit report
steps.narration: Opening it shows how well that fact-checker grades itself, tested against 200 fake patterns it should always reject.
steps.point_out: Four numbers load right away — 200 test trials, a 0.08 false-alarm rate, the 0.05 bar it's held to, and the date this check last ran.

steps.title: See the tripwire warning
steps.narration: The real test: a pattern that secretly peeks at future prices was slipped in, just to see if the fact-checker would catch the cheat.
steps.point_out: It didn't catch it this time — so instead of staying quiet, the page shows a loud red warning explaining exactly what happened.

expect.text: the lookahead-contaminated factor was NOT rejected

steps.title: Back to the Research hub
steps.narration: Heading back to Research shows the new report sitting comfortably alongside the ones that were already there.
steps.point_out: All four governance cards are present, in the same order as before — nothing else moved.

steps.title: Confirm the budget card still works
steps.narration: A quick check that nothing else broke — the existing budget-tracking card still opens exactly like it always has.
steps.point_out: Its own numbers load normally, confirming this update didn't disturb its neighbors.

steps.title: Confirm the evidence ledger is untouched
steps.narration: One last check: did any of those 200 practice trials accidentally sneak into Trendora's real evidence ledger?
steps.point_out: They didn't — the evidence page looks exactly as it did before, still honestly marked, with nothing new added.
